heading: Repealed. Pub. L. 119–60, div. H, title LXXXII, § 8202(h), Dec. 18, 2025, 139 Stat. 1844

notes.text: Section, Pub. L. 110–401, title II, § 201, Oct. 13, 2008, 122 Stat. 4241, provided for the establishment of additional computer forensic capacity to address the current backlog for computer forensics.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section was formerly classified to section 17631 of Title 42, The Public Health and Welfare, prior to editorial reclassification and renumbering as this section.
